_doc: Shot recipe blocks for the Create (video) and Image screens. Each category is one dropdown; picking an option appends its text to the prompt as a sentence, in category order. Written as plain visual description (what is on screen), because Wan and Qwen follow that better than instructions. Daniel's own blocks are saved by the Studio to prompt_library.local.json (git-ignored) and appear after these. Camera moves follow the 46-move list from aicameramovements.com (names and grouping only; the descriptions are our own).

options.label: Static shot
options.text: The camera stays completely still for the whole shot; only the subject and the scene move.

options.label: Pan right
options.text: The camera stays in place and turns slowly to the right across the scene.

options.label: Pan left
options.text: The camera stays in place and turns slowly to the left across the scene.

options.label: Whip pan right
options.text: The camera whips suddenly to the right in a fast blurred snap, landing on a new subject.

options.label: Whip pan left
options.text: The camera whips suddenly to the left in a fast blurred snap, landing on a new subject.

options.label: Tilt up
options.text: The camera stays in place and tilts slowly upward, from the ground up to the subject's face.

options.label: Tilt down
options.text: The camera stays in place and tilts slowly downward, from the subject's face down to the ground.

options.label: Slow zoom in
options.text: The view slowly and gradually zooms in on the main subject, ending on a tighter frame.

options.label: Slow zoom out
options.text: The view slowly and gradually zooms out from the main subject, revealing more of the scene.

options.label: Fast zoom in
options.text: The view zooms in quickly and decisively onto the main subject.

options.label: Fast zoom out
options.text: The view zooms out quickly and decisively away from the main subject.

options.label: Crash zoom in
options.text: The view snaps abruptly from wide straight onto the main subject, ending on a punchy close-up.

options.label: Crash zoom out
options.text: The view starts close on the main subject, then snaps abruptly outward as the surrounding space rushes into view, ending on a bold wide composition.

options.label: Dolly in
options.text: The camera moves slowly and steadily forward in a straight line toward the main subject, keeping the same height, until the subject fills more of the frame.

options.label: Dolly out
options.text: The camera moves slowly and steadily backward in a straight line away from the main subject, revealing more of the surroundings.

options.label: Tracking shot
options.text: The camera moves smoothly through the scene alongside the subject, keeping pace with them.

options.label: Follow / over the shoulder
options.text: The camera follows close behind the subject at shoulder height, their shoulder and the back of their head in the foreground.

options.label: Reverse tracking (walk and talk)
options.text: The camera moves backward in front of the subject as they walk toward it, keeping their face in frame.

options.label: Side tracking
options.text: The camera moves sideways alongside the subject, parallel to their path, keeping them in profile.

options.label: Low tracking
options.text: The camera glides just above the ground beside the subject at the speed of their steps, the ground sliding through the bottom of the frame.

options.label: Vehicle tracking
options.text: The camera travels alongside the moving vehicle at the same speed, the road and scenery streaming past.

options.label: Chase shot
options.text: The camera races close behind the fleeing subject, fast and urgent, shaking with the pursuit.

options.label: Truck right
options.text: The camera slides sideways to the right in a straight line, keeping the subject in view.

options.label: Truck left
options.text: The camera slides sideways to the left in a straight line, keeping the subject in view.

options.label: Pedestal up
options.text: The whole camera rises straight up, staying level, revealing the scene from higher.

options.label: Pedestal down
options.text: The whole camera lowers straight down, staying level, ending at a lower viewpoint.

options.label: Slider right
options.text: The camera makes a short smooth slide to the right, foreground and background shifting against each other.

options.label: Slider left
options.text: The camera makes a short smooth slide to the left, foreground and background shifting against each other.

options.label: Push past
options.text: The camera glides forward past a blurred object in the foreground, revealing the subject beyond it.

options.label: Arc right
options.text: The camera moves in a slow, smooth curve to the right around the main subject, same distance and height, ending on a new right-side angle.

options.label: Arc left
options.text: The camera moves in a slow, smooth curve to the left around the main subject, same distance and height, ending on a new left-side angle.

options.label: Orbit clockwise
options.text: The camera circles all the way around the main subject clockwise at a steady distance and height.

options.label: Orbit counterclockwise
options.text: The camera circles all the way around the main subject counterclockwise at a steady distance and height.

options.label: Handheld
options.text: The camera is handheld at eye level, swaying slightly and naturally with the operator's breathing and steps.

options.label: Body-mounted (Snorricam)
options.text: The camera is fixed to the subject's chest facing their face, which stays still in frame while the background lurches and swings behind them.

options.label: Crane up
options.text: The camera rises slowly and smoothly upward, looking down as more of the scene comes into view.

options.label: Crane down
options.text: The camera descends slowly and smoothly from high above down toward the subject.

options.label: Drone push in
options.text: An aerial camera glides forward high above the ground toward the destination.

options.label: Drone pull back
options.text: An aerial camera flies backward and upward away from the subject, revealing the wide landscape.

options.label: Helicopter shot
options.text: A high aerial view sweeping slowly and broadly over the landscape.

options.label: First-person view
options.text: First-person view from the character's eyes moving forward, their hands visible at the bottom of the frame.

options.label: Tilt-shift
options.text: Tilt-shift miniature look, only a narrow band in the middle sharp, the top and bottom blurred.

options.label: Infinite zoom
options.text: The view zooms continuously inward toward the center of the frame, deeper and deeper.

options.label: Earth zoom out
options.text: The view rockets upward and away from the street, past rooftops and clouds, until the whole planet is visible.

options.label: Time-lapse
options.text: The camera stays fixed while time passes quickly, clouds and light racing across the scene.

options.label: Pass through
options.text: The camera moves straight through the window into the room beyond.

options.label: Real time
options.text: Everything moves at natural, real-time speed.

options.label: Slow motion
options.text: Everything moves in smooth slow motion.

options.label: Tense and still
options.text: The subjects barely move, holding perfectly still with tension.

options.label: Fast and violent
options.text: The action is sudden, fast and violent.

options.label: Smooth gimbal
options.text: The camera motion is perfectly smooth and stable.

options.label: Handheld shake
options.text: The camera is handheld with a slight natural shake.

options.label: Documentary
options.text: Raw documentary camera work, slightly unsteady, reacting to the action.

options.label: Rain falling
options.text: Rain falls steadily through the frame and splashes on the ground.

options.label: Smoke drifting
options.text: Smoke drifts slowly through the air.

options.label: Wind
options.text: Wind moves through hair and clothing.

options.label: Neon flicker
options.text: Neon signs flicker, their colored light pulsing on wet surfaces.

options.label: Dust in light
options.text: Dust floats in shafts of light.

options.label: Extreme wide
options.text: Extreme wide shot, the people small in a large environment.

options.label: Wide
options.text: Wide shot, full bodies in frame with the surroundings visible.

options.label: Medium
options.text: Medium shot, framed from the waist up.

options.label: Close-up
options.text: Close-up on the face.

options.label: Extreme close-up
options.text: Extreme close-up on the eyes.

options.label: Over the shoulder
options.text: Over-the-shoulder shot, one person's shoulder soft in the foreground, the other in focus beyond.

options.label: Two-shot
options.text: Two-shot, both people fully in frame facing each other.

options.label: Eye level
options.text: Camera at eye level.

options.label: Low angle
options.text: Low camera angle looking up, making the subject look powerful.

options.label: High angle
options.text: High camera angle looking down on the subject.

options.label: Dutch tilt
options.text: Tilted dutch angle, the horizon off-level, uneasy.

options.label: Overhead
options.text: Straight-down overhead view.

options.label: 24mm wide
options.text: Shot on a 24mm wide-angle lens, deep perspective.

options.label: 35mm
options.text: Shot on a 35mm lens, natural perspective.

options.label: 50mm
options.text: Shot on a 50mm lens.

options.label: 85mm portrait
options.text: Shot on an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, background softly blurred.

options.label: Anamorphic
options.text: Anamorphic lens, oval bokeh and horizontal lens flares.

options.label: Neon noir
options.text: Night, red and blue neon light reflecting on wet surfaces, deep shadows.

options.label: Golden hour
options.text: Warm golden-hour sunlight, long soft shadows.

options.label: Harsh overhead
options.text: A single harsh overhead light, hard shadows under the eyes.

options.label: Moonlight
options.text: Cold blue moonlight, dark and quiet.

options.label: Practical lamps
options.text: Lit only by practical lamps in the scene, warm pools of light in darkness.

options.label: Overcast day
options.text: Flat overcast daylight, muted colors.

options.label: 35mm film still
options.text: Cinematic 35mm film still, natural film grain.

options.label: Clean digital cinema
options.text: Clean, sharp digital cinema look.

options.label: Grainy 16mm
options.text: Grainy 16mm film, soft and gritty.

options.label: Black-and-white noir
options.text: High-contrast black-and-white film noir.

options.label: Teal and orange
options.text: Blockbuster teal-and-orange color grade.
